==Usage instructions==
Please refer to [[Wookieepedia:Speedy deletions]]. Place the following code on the page to be deleted and replace "reason" with the reason why the article is a candidate for speedy deletion. If it is a repost of a previously-deleted article, use "again" as the first parameter.

<pre><nowiki>
{{Delete|''REASON''}}
</nowiki></pre>
